name: 大额支付退款失败订单查询
description: 查询大额支付工具(pay_channel_api=90200001, channel_name=185)的退款失败订单(state=4)。由于JOIN大表在Presto引擎会超内存，采用单表查询+手动关联方式。

steps.name: step1_refund_detail
steps.sql:
SELECT 
    payment_detail_no,
    refund_detail_no,
    trade_no,
    amount / 100 AS refundAmount_yuan,
    state,
    error_reason,
    created_at
FROM ods.pay_pc_refund_detail
WHERE pay_channel_api = '90200001'
    AND channel_name = '185'
    AND state = 4
    AND created_at >= '{{start_time}}'
    AND created_at < '{{end_time}}'
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 1000

steps.name: step2_trade_info
steps.sql: SELECT trade_no, outer_trade_no, payee_id FROM ods.pay_tc_trade WHERE trade_no IN ({{trade_no_list}})

steps.name: step3_payment_info
steps.sql: SELECT payment_detail_no, external_payment_no, amount / 100 AS payAmount_yuan FROM ods.pay_pc_payment_detail WHERE payment_detail_no IN ({{payment_detail_no_list}})

note: 由于单表查询返回结果有限，完整数据需要分三步查询：1)查退款明细 2)根据trade_no查交易信息 3)根据payment_detail_no查支付信息。最后手动合并结果。
